name: Audit and Provenance verifies cryptographic hash continuity
description: Opening the Audit & Provenance tab and clicking Verify Audit Chain performs SHA-256 integrity validation.

planSteps.description: Click on the Audit & Provenance tab in the navigation bar
Verify the sequential SHA-256 hash chain verification banner is visible
Click the Verify Audit Chain button
Verify the status badge displays CHAIN VERIFIED indicating cryptographic continuity
